# ClinGen ERepo fixtures

`apc-detail.json` is a byte-faithful capture from
`https://erepo.clinicalgenome.org/evrepo/api/summary/classification/34ea9707-51d8-44df-818d-f69b075295c5/doc/sepio/version/1.0.0`,
captured 2026-08-03T00:03:40Z (2026-08-02 local). Its SHA-256 is
`f6b1e4bfd2359a4d648626a87d487c4d92e5f2cc723de9347139218c03abad46`.

`gp1ba-guideline.html` and `mtdna-guideline.html` are dated provider captures
from 2026-08-12, minimized to the single `p.cspec-svi-text` element consumed by
the production guideline parser. Their complete request and minimization
records are in `testdata/sources/capture-receipts.json`.
